payload.title: Three spellings of 'owns a fixture suite' can disagree because validate_tool_definition lets an agent-backed row declare fixture_set: is_agent_backed (adapter_fixture_contract), key presence (funnel_health, pr_tracking) and truthiness (fixture_runner)
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/tool_registry.py:963-964 (fixture_set is validated only when the row requires it, so an agent-backed row may also carry one)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/tool_registry.py:1071-1079 (an agent runner is validated on its own fields; nothing forbids fixture_set on the row)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/funnel_health.py:259-261 (key presence decides which tools have fixture runs read)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/pr_tracking.py:703-708 (key presence decides which tools a merge can impact and builds the pattern from the value)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/fixture_runner.py:608-610 (truthiness decides which tools get a suite refresh)
aria-kernel/tests/test_agent_backed_tool_kind.py:62-73 (the pin covers the shipped manifest and subprocess rows, not an agent-backed row that declares fixture_set)
payload.rule_violated: One predicate per fact (CLAUDE.md Single center, no duplicates; tool_registry.required_tool_fields is the owner of 'an agent-backed tool owns no fixture suite')
payload.notes: A manifest author who copies an adapter manifest into an agent-backed one and keeps fixture_set gets it validated (probed at d716541239: the validated row is agent-backed and carries fixture_set), assert_fixture_backed returns no cases, while pr_tracking._impacted_adapters treats the tool as a suite owner and reports it impacted by merges under that path, and funnel_health reads fixture runs for it. The shipped change-review manifest has no fixture_set, so this is not reachable today. Close condition: Make validate_tool_definition refuse fixture_set on an agent-backed row by name and have the readers ask the registry's one predicate instead of key presence or truthiness. Test: validate_tool_definition of the change-review manifest plus a fixture_set raises GovernanceError. Plan row: D3 (program finding ARIA-MEDIUM-761). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
